cancel.question: How can I cancel my subscription?
cancel.answer: You can cancel your subscription anytime from App Store settings for iOS or Google Play settings for Android. After cancellation, you will continue to enjoy premium features until the end of the current period.

locationInfo.body: Journeo uses your location data to provide you with the best travel experience: GPS location for real-time navigation, to show nearby points of interest, and to generate AI-powered route suggestions. Location data is only collected while using the app and is not shared without your permission.
